title: Weighted influence sum
statement: For the specified real-valued function on the three-dimensional cube of signs and its specified randomized decision tree, the sum over coordinates of the probability that the tree queries that coordinate, multiplied by the coordinate influence of the function under the uniform sign distribution, equals $11/8+3\sqrt{33}/16$.
caveat: The declaration excerpt does not provide the definition of the named randomized decision tree.
